name: hook microtubule tethering protein 2

function.text: HOOK2 is the approved symbol for hook microtubule tethering protein 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in dynein light intermediate chain binding; microtubule binding; cytoplasmic microtubule organization.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Prostate adenocarcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HOOK2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and prostate adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
